lesson.child_mission: Area is the amount of surface a shape covers, measured in square units — not the distance around (perimeter).
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.
lesson.extension: Apply the same method to a larger number or a new context, then compare two solution paths for accuracy.
lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Which is area: (a) fencing around a garden (b) grass covering the garden? Estimate area of a book cover in square sticky notes.

FEEDBACK
(b). Estimate equals how many notes cover the cover without big gaps.

WATCH FOR
Counting only around the edge when asked for area confuses perimeter with area.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write a definition of area with two examples and one perimeter non-example. Cover three rectangles with square grids (draw or tiles) and record areas in square units.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.
